messages:
maria: Quick sync — opened SDK PR that renames Client header; it requires an API change to accept both old/new headers and a helm chart patch to bump the image tag. PRs: api#3245, sdk#7781, charts#88. Planning to merge sdk -> api -> charts. Any blockers?
kevin: I can review api#3245 later today. Does the api change need any migration steps or config flags?
sarah: Pinging me for charts sequencing — if api changes are backward compatible we can cut the chart after api is canaryed. What's the target rollout window?
maria: No DB or schema changes, just header parsing to accept `X-Redwood-Client-Version: 2` alongside legacy header. Diff is tiny. Target rollout: canary to staging, then production in next deploy window.
ci-bot: api#3245 — integration-windows failed: timeout after 12m. Rerun queued by @kevin.
kevin: Re-running now. If it passes I'll give an approval. Also @david can you take sdk review? QA flagged one doc nit but sdk tests all green.
david: I'll do a quick pass on sdk#7781. Docs nit — is there a small README update or an SDK changelog entry? If present I'll approve.
maria: Docs updated in sdk#7781 (tiny changelog entry). Sequence I'm proposing: kevin approves api -> merge sdk (feature-gated) -> sarah publishes charts#88 -> canary rollout. OK?
sarah: :thumbsup: Works for me. I'll queue chart publish once I see the api merge and a staging canary.
kevin: api CI passed on rerun. Approved and merging in ~10m.
maria: Thanks all — I'll post merge comments and estimated prod timeline after the merge.
